verdict.rationale: Meta's own safety blog says users who do not want their data used in model training can opt out with a simple switch in Muse settings. It also discloses the default: trajectories are sanitized of key PII and then used for training. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out switch exists and works, and detail on its scope (e.g., whether it covers past data).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: If you do not want your data to be used in model training at all, you can opt-out via a simple switch in Muse settings.
